instruction: Replace mccabe's hand-written argument parsing in `main` with `argparse`, keeping `-m/--min`, the positional file argument and the exit codes. Usage text will change; nothing else may. Work on the file, then run `run_verify`: it checks a change you have made, so it is a check on your change, never the goal. If no change is warranted, say so with `give_up` and the evidence, rather than submitting unchanged code.
